prompt: A wide open prairie of wheat-gold grass stretching to a low flat horizon under an enormous sky, golden-hour sunlight flooding the scene from a warm cream-white sun resting on the horizon. Long crepuscular rays fan across the grass, and the only source of light is that low sun, casting long soft shadows over the swaying grass. The background is a vast pale-gold sky fading to soft cream-white near the sun, scattered with a few high wisps of cloud.

A solitary weathered white marble standing stone, a tall sun-altar megalith, rising from open windswept grassland at dawn, carved with worn sacred sigils and haloed in a soft luminous white glow as it catches the first cream-gold light. The only source of light is the dawn glow welling from the white stone. The background is rolling pale-green plains under a wide rose-and-gold dawn sky, a thin bright horizon behind the monolith.

Neatly cultivated farmland on an open plain, parallel furrowed rows of pale-gold wheat converging toward a small white-walled chapel with a slender spire standing on the far horizon. Low wooden split-rail fences edge the field. Warm midday sunlight floods the ordered rows from a bright cream-white sky. The background is a wide pale-blue and cream sky above the distant white chapel and a thin green treeline.

A worn dirt path winding through tall sun-bleached prairie grass on a vast flat plain, the path leading the eye off toward a brilliant low cream-white sun near the right horizon. Seen from a low ground-level camera so the grass towers in the foreground. Long golden crepuscular rays rake across the field. The background is an immense warm gold-and-peach evening sky, the horizon a thin glowing line.

A single great pale-barked oak tree standing alone in the middle of a vast open prairie of golden grass, its broad canopy of soft sage-green leaves the one landmark on a flat sunlit plain. Warm clear midday light, a few long shadows stretching from the lone tree across the grass. The background is a wide bright cream-and-pale-blue sky meeting a flat distant horizon.

Rolling green-and-gold grassy hills of an open plain on a bright clear day, soft dappled cloud-shadows drifting across the sunlit grass, a wide sweep of emerald and wheat-gold meadow rising and falling to a far horizon. Crisp white midday sunlight. The background is a vast bright sky of soft white cumulus clouds against pale blue, the only light a clean noon sun high above.

A small white-stone walled town with red-tiled roofs and a central spire crowning a low green hill, overlooking a wide open plain of golden grassland at dawn. Banners and a road wind down from the gatehouse into the fields. Warm first light gilds the pale stone walls. The background is a broad pale-gold and soft-blue dawn sky behind the hilltop settlement, the plain rolling away below it.

A high aerial view looking down across a vast patchwork of golden wheat fields and pale-green pasture on an open plain, divided by dark hedgerows and a winding dirt road, a tiny white farmstead nestled among the fields. Bright clear daylight from high above casts crisp small shadows. The background, near the top, is a thin strip of pale horizon sky above the wide quilted farmland.

Neatly cultivated farmland on an open plain, parallel furrowed rows of pale-gold wheat sweeping with strong perspective toward a small white-walled chapel with a slender spire on the far horizon. A low wooden split-rail fence edges the field. Warm clear sunlight floods the ordered rows from a bright cream-white sky. The background is a wide pale-blue and cream sky above the distant white chapel and a thin green treeline.

A peaceful open pasture on a green-and-gold plain, a small flock of fluffy white sheep grazing on the sunlit grass beside a low wooden fence, the meadow rolling away to a flat distant horizon. Warm clear midday light, soft shadows under the grazing sheep. The background is a wide bright sky of pale blue and soft white clouds above the open grassland.
